name: atask create-task e2e (localhost)
_doc: Goi API tao task tren atask localhost qua /api/ai/execute (PAT), roi SELECT bang `task` de xac nhan row that su duoc tao -> dam bao tinh nang dung. Auth: dat API_BASE_URL + API_AUTH_HEADER='X-aTask-PAT: <token>' qua env/registry (flow_check.api tu doc API_AUTH_HEADER). DB: dat --project atask --env <env> (hoac DB_* inline). Seed bien: --var listId=<list_task_id_that> --var taskName='e2e probe task'. CANH BAO: day la GHI - chay vao DB cuc bo/co lap, KHONG vao prod.

steps.name: POST /api/ai/execute create_task
steps._note: Chinh '$.data.id' cho khop response that cua /api/ai/execute (co the la $.result.id / $.id). Chay rieng buoc nay 1 lan de xem JSON tra ve roi sua path.

steps.name: row task vua tao co trong DB
steps.sql: select id, name from task where id = '{newTaskId}'

steps.name: ten task khop voi input
